mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contractors (user_id, company_name, business_number, career, certifications, preferred_types, service_area, introduction, portfolio_images) VALUES (#{userId}, #{companyName}, #{businessNumber}, #{career}, #{certifications}, #{preferredTypes}, #{serviceArea}, #{introduction}, #{portfolioImages})
mapper.update: UPDATE contractors SET company_name = #{companyName}, business_number = #{businessNumber}, career = #{career}, certifications = #{certifications}, preferred_types = #{preferredTypes}, service_area = #{serviceArea}, introduction = #{introduction}, portfolio_images = #{portfolioImages} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE contractors SET is_banned = #{isBanned} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE contractors c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT contractor_id, ROUND(AVG(rating), 2) AS avg_rating, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM reviews WHERE is_hidden = 0 GROUP BY contractor_id ) r ON r.contractor_id = c.id SET c.average_rating = COALESCE(r.avg_rating, 0), c.review_count = COALESCE(r.cnt, 0) WHERE c.id = #{id}
